caption: The drawing consists of a single round bowl with a slightly concave interior depicted in grayscale pencil shading, giving it a metallic appearance. Attached to the top of the bowl is an ornate, pierced handle featuring a symmetrical, scrollwork design with cutout shapes. The bowl and handle are centered within a large rectangular border on a plain, off-white or beige background. In the bottom right corner of the main rectangle, there is a smaller inset drawing showing a side profile of the bowl, along with precise measurements: the bowl has a diameter of 2 3/4 inches, a height of 3/4 inches, and the handle extends 1 1/4 inches beyond the rim. At the bottom left of the main drawing, the name "Charles Cullen" is handwritten in cursive.
title: Pewter Porringer
